lines.beaver: 수아 씨, 얼굴이 안 좋아요. 무슨 일 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: Sua, you don't look well. What's wrong?
lines.beaver_roman: Sua ssi, eolguri an joayo. Museun nil isseoyo?
lines.learner: 사실 요즘 고민이 있어요. 들어 줄래요?
lines.en: Actually, I've been worried lately. Will you listen?
lines.roman: Sasil yojeum gomini isseoyo. Deureo jullaeyo?

lines.beaver_en: Of course. Take your time and tell me.
lines.en: I've lost interest in my work. I feel so frustrated.

lines.learner: 잘 기억나지 않아요. 몇 달 전부터요.
lines.en: I don't really remember. A few months ago.
lines.roman: Jal gieongnaji anayo. Myeot ttal jeonbuteoyo.

lines.beaver_en: How was it when you first joined?
lines.en: It was fun then. I've forgotten that feeling.

lines.beaver_en: Is there something you want to do now?
lines.learner: 잘 모르겠어요. 제가 뭘 원하는지도 몰라요.
lines.en: I'm not sure. I don't even know what I want.
lines.roman: Jal moreugesseoyo. Jega mwol wonhaneunjido mollayo.

lines.beaver_en: Try writing down things you're interested in.
lines.learner: 어릴 때 그림을 좋아했던 게 기억나요.
lines.en: I remember I loved drawing as a kid.
lines.roman: Eoril ttae geurimeul joahaetdeon ge gieongnayo.

lines.learner: 주말에 그림 수업을 들어 보고 싶어요.
lines.en: I'd like to try a drawing class on weekends.
lines.roman: Jumare geurim sueobeul deureo bogo sipeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Great idea. You should try it.
lines.learner: 민지 씨도 한번 해 보세요. 같이 가요!
lines.en: You should try it too, Minji. Let's go together!
lines.roman: Minji ssido hanbeon hae boseyo. Gachi gayo!

lines.beaver_en: Sure. How do you feel now?
lines.en: Talking about it made me feel lighter.

lines.beaver_en: I'm glad. I hope everything goes well.
lines.en: Thank you. I hope so too.
